```python
# filename: compute_type_averages.py
import pandas as pd
import tabula

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/67e8878b-5cef-4375-804e-e6291fdbe78a.pdf"
# Recreate final_df within this script
frames = tabula.read_pdf(pdf_path, pages='all', multiple_tables=True)
d = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
section_types = ["Hotels", "Motels", "Villas", "Guesthouses", "Inns", "Resorts", "Cottages", "B&Bs"]
cur = None
assigned = []
for _, r in d.iterrows():
    nm = str(r.get('Name', '')).strip()
    if nm in section_types:
        cur = nm
        assigned.append(None)
    else:
        assigned.append(cur)

d['Type'] = assigned
clean = d[(d['Type'].notnull()) & (d['Rating (out of 5)'].notnull())]
final_df = clean[['Name', 'Type', 'Rating (out of 5)']]

summary = final_df.groupby('Type').agg(
    Number_of_Listings=('Name', 'count'),
    Average_Rating=('Rating (out of 5)', 'mean')
).reset_index()

print(summary)
print("\nTop type by average:", summary.loc[summary['Average_Rating'].idxmax(), 'Type'])
```

```python
assigned = []
for _, r in df.iterrows():
    nm = str(r.get('Name', '')).strip()
    if nm in headers:
        cur = nm
        assigned.append(None)
    else:
        assigned.append(cur)

).reset_index()

print("\nType with highest filtered average:", summary2.loc[summary2['Average_Rating'].idxmax(), 'Type'])
``` 
